# Regression

[I use this book as a foundation for this analysis](https://tidy-survey-r.github.io/tidy-survey-book/).

**Input**

-   DemographyGunOwners/data/raw/gunsurvey/...dta

**Output**

-   DemographyGunOwners/data/raw/gunsurvey/...rds

**Last ran** - 12/14/2025

```{r,  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

packages <-
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "purrr",
    "haven",
    "tidyr",
    "janitor",
    "dplyr",
    "here",
    "survey"
  )

pacman::p_load(
  packages,
  character.only = TRUE
)
```

## Import data

```{r}
data <-
  read_rds(
    here(
    path_od, 
    "data",
    "clean",
    "gs-2021.rds"
    )
)
```

Post-strat weights adjust your sample so that it matches known population totals (e.g. by age × sex × race × region).


## Reg


```{r}
library(survey)

design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~psu,
  strata = ~strata,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = df,
  nest = TRUE
)

model <- svyglm(
  y ~ x1 + x2,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

```
